prior.note: resume() now returns unless a seated online context exists and the phase is not idle or error, and no exit or disposal is in flight (onlineSession.ts:L547). Leave goes through prepareExit -> stop (L483, L536), and stop clears `context` (L113), so a persisted `saved` credential alone no longer triggers a reconnect. Idle suspend is a no-op (L543: `if (!c) return`). After retirement, current(c) is checked again before dispatching (L550). The renderer also closes a delivered port unless the router is already online (main.ts onPort guard, using sessionRouter.ts:L9 `mode`), which stops an unsolicited couch-to-online switch. The regressions in onlineRecovery.test.ts cover initial idle and post-Leave suspend/resume.

On the host, a retryable credential failure during acquisition now retires only that peer. It schedules one owned per-seat timer at the cooldown deadline instead of calling session onFailure (onlinePeers.ts:L124-L137). The delay equals blocked - now, so when the timer fires `blocked > now` is false and reconcile proceeds (L163). The `attempted` map is per drain, so a new reconcile can re-issue. The timer checks the owner identity before reissuing (L134) and is cleared on replacement and on dispose (L130, L186). onlineIce marks rate-limited, capacity and turn-unavailable as retryable with retryAfterMs (onlineIce.ts:L14, L43, L51-L58), so the cited cases take the peer-scoped path. Guests keep the session-level failure, which is one of the fixes the finding itself proposed. The new test uses the real createOnlineIce in turn mode and covers both the retry and the dispose path.

verified: onlinePeers.ts:L119-L140: on the host, a retryable acquisition failure retires the link and schedules a retry; a non-retryable or guest failure still calls failed(error); a failure after start still calls lost().
onlinePeers.ts:L186: dispose clears every retry timer before releasing the peers.
onlineSession.ts:L111-L123: stop() clears context, so resume after Leave or Forget is a no-op.
onlineSession.ts:L543-L551: suspend and resume guards, including the exitWork and disposal checks and the post-retirement current(c) check.
sessionRouter.ts:L6-L11: `mode` getter exists and defaults to 'home', so the renderer port guard closes the port in home and couch modes.
onlineIce.ts:L14, L43, L51-L58: the error codes and retryability flags that the host retry path keys on.
